name: SkyFlixer
description: SkyFlixer (skyflixer.fun) - free movies, TV shows, anime & cartoons. TMDB-powered catalog with rows for Hindi movies, anime and kids' cartoons, streamed from SkyFlixer's full multi-host server list - every online host is queried (CastVid, Citadel, AwsPly, Nitro, Multi-blue, Prvibd and more), not a fixed subset. Each manifest is fetched before it is offered, so dead links are filtered out rather than shown. Default audio: Hindi - Hindi-dubbed tracks are ranked first, then English, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, Malayalam and Bengali. Verified live.
